attempt_result.error: RuntimeError: expected exactly one accepted and one cancelled event

mutation_analysis.basis: The exception occurs inside engine.begin() before the first store_reconciliation_run() call. Context-manager rollback applies on exception.

root_cause.privileged_consumer_contract: The Telegram privileged consumer persists the exact executor result to /var/lib/bp-canary/telegram-live-handoff/*.result.json.
root_cause.missing_behavior: The privileged consumer does not call record_canary_submission() and does not write accepted/cancelled live_order_events.
root_cause.incorrect_helper_assumption: The second-canary helper inherited the first-canary prerequisite that recorder DB already contains exactly one accepted and one cancelled event.

engineering_repair.helper_behavior: Verify exactly one exact executor result receipt. Accept either exactly one accepted+cancelled normalized pair or a completely empty normalized event history; empty history is allowed only when the executor receipt is exact. Any partial or ambiguous event history fails closed.
engineering_repair.account_snapshot_behavior: A clean exact post_submission_official_zero_fill reconciliation resolves that intent to zero exposure. Malformed evidence does not clear exposure and leaves the intent critical.
